definitions.explanation: Someone who supports you or is on your side.
As a suru-verb, to take someone's side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{味方|みかた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{味方|みかた}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ほしい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧。
examples.english: I want you to make clear whether you're friend or foe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{困|こま}った→困る：00861_komaru⟧⟦とき→時：02918_toki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味方|みかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

examples.english: She is always on the side of the weak, and is trusted by everyone.

examples.english: Thanks to the department head siding with me at the meeting, the proposal was approved.

notes:
{味方|みかた} refers to someone on your side — an ally, supporter, or friend. As a noun it describes the person or group that supports you; as a suru verb it means to take someone's side.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {味方|みかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an ally
- {味方|みかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つく→付く：01960_tsuku⟧: to take someone's side
- {味方|みかた}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to side with someone
- ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{味方|みかた}⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: friend or foe
- ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{味方|みかた}: a strong ally/supporter

USAGE:
The verb form {味方|みかた}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ marks the person being supported with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧, not ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧: ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{味方|みかた}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to side with one's younger brother). The noun pattern ⟦{弟|おとうと}→弟：00572_otouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{味方|みかた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means the same thing and is at least as common in speech.

⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ appears with {味方|みかた} in the set phrase {味方|みかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to win someone over to your side), where ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ marks the person being recruited: ⟦{世論|よろん}→世論：16145_yoron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{味方|みかた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to get public opinion on your side).

WATCH OUT:
Distinguish from ⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧ (point of view, way of looking at things) — same reading, different kanji and meaning.
